title: Prism Pear Drop Hoops
descriptionHtml:
A huggie, and three colours falling from it. A plain polished gold tone huggie hoop carries a drop of three pear cut cubic zirconia, points up: raspberry pink, then lilac, then canary yellow, each in fine gold claws. About 21mm long in all, they fall just below the lobe and move with every turn of the head.

STYLING TIP: Wear them with the Prism Pear Drop Necklace, hair tucked back.

Details

  • Length: Approximately 21mm
  • Hoop: Plain polished huggie hoop, approximately 8.5mm
  • Stone: Pear cut cubic zirconia in raspberry pink, lilac and canary yellow
  • Setting: Fine gold claws
  • Finish: Polished gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
